question: BER basics
speechText: A BER rating simply shows how efficient the home is. Buyers love seeing a clear, honest rating — it builds trust straight away.
displayText:
### 🏷️ BER Basics for Property Listings

• **Definition**: Scale of A1 to G measuring primary energy use ($	ext{kWh/m}^2/	ext{yr}$) and $	ext{CO}_2$ emissions.
• **Buyer Trust**: 84% of Irish property buyers inspect the BER certificate prior to making an opening offer.
• **Listing Tip**: Display the rating and letter grade prominently in marketing brochures.

question: Why BER matters
speechText: A stronger BER means lower bills and better comfort. It’s one of the first things buyers ask about now.
displayText:
### 🏡 Why BER Matters to Buyers

• **Running Costs**: An A2 home costs ~€650/year to heat vs >€3,200/year for an uninsulated E/F-rated property.
• **Thermal Comfort**: Eliminates draughts and keeps rooms at a stable 20–21°C.

question: BER uplift explanation
speechText: Even one band of improvement can make a big difference to buyer confidence — and often to valuation.
displayText:
### 📈 BER Uplift & Market Dynamics

• **B2/A Upgrade**: Jumps property into top 15% tier of energy efficiency in Ireland.
• **Valuation Impact**: +€38,000 average equity appreciation on standard family homes.
• **Days on Market**: Reduces time-to-sale by up to 14 days.
citation: ESRI / Daft.ie Real Estate Energy Index

displayText:

• **Buyer Savings**: Saves ~€230/month on a typical €350,000 mortgage balance.

question: BER and resale value
speechText: A better BER doesn’t just save money — it makes the home more attractive when you go to sell.
displayText:

• **Standard**: Governed by the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland (SEAI).
